span.p:
Refused: catastrophic
(rm -rf /, wiping home, disk writes)

span.p:
Allowed: plain reads and ordinary
edits inside the workspace

Always asked: sudo, pushes,
credentials, installs

span.p:
2. Classifier model (Jev)
sees only your request and the call,
redacted, never tool output or web pages

3. You decide
TUI dialog · Telegram buttons · web card
(a diff preview for file edits)
